## Completion receipt

- Source: base SHA / final reviewed head SHA / merge SHA or NOT MERGED
- Scope: affected components
- Verification: exact commands, environment, counts/results, evidence links
- Independent review: receipt and reviewed SHA; security/UX result or N/A reason
- Release: source merged, deployed, submitted, public, device-tested (separate states)
- Communication: issue -> posted reply link, or draft/pending with reason
- Open: incomplete acceptance/requests, next action and exact resume command
